items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: I associate them with Sharky... Sharky lived out in Lake Vista. I lived on Snipe Street. And Sharky wasn't far?

ctx.x: Yeah, oh I saw him a couple of years ago. And he had his little grandson used to dance every once in a while. But I'm trying to think that pork chops and kidney stew come up there.
They may have, but I associate them with Sharky, but they could have been doing it. They could have been working different places.
Yeah, it's confusing. It seems to me that I knew pork chops and kidney stew, but I can't remember now if it was from the Parisian room or from with Sharky's thing.
